fusions.name: Pollen Draw
fusions.desc: Sends a bee that deals 7 nature damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Swarm Forage
fusions.desc: Looses 4 bees at once, spread apart, each dealing 2 poison damage with a 25% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 6 seconds. 12% of the damage dealt returns to you as healing over 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Royal Jelly
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 40% for 15 seconds and restores 12 health.

fusions.name: Nurse of the Comb
fusions.desc: A bonded nurse bee flies with you, striking enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second and leaving them [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Each kill restores 2 health to you.
